note: Three campgrounds in the Roaring River valley near Cassville, about 1.3 km apart. The spring-fed river here is a stream about 15-25 m wide; Campground 2's sites 093-094 at the end of its loop sit on the bank, and the lower Campground 1 sites (070-072) are a short walk through woods from it. Campground 1 stays open year-round with its showerhouse and frost-free water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15-16 basic base, electric +12, full hookup +20 (2026 = 2027); added 50A/water/sewer, 169 sites (pads 41-80 ft; stored 187 from note prose), showers/flush/laundry/dump/water/store, military $2, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, reservations year-round (CG1). Riverfront -> creekside (channel ~15-25 m at the sites). Pin sits in Campground 1: kept.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> creekside (on-water kept, label by width): the Roaring River at the campgrounds measures ~15-25 m of open water on leaf-off Esri imagery (a gravel bed ~10-15 m by lower Campground 1) - under the ~30 m line, so creekside under AWH's 2026-11-01 width rule. Per campground against the NHD flowline: Campground 2's 093/094 sit 18-29 m from the channel centreline at the end of the loop with open gravel bank between and no road (on-water); Campground 2's 095-098 are 20-25 m from the centreline but the loop road runs between them and the water (*view at best); Campground 1's lower 070-072 / F073 / F075 / 077 are 17-34 m from the centreline through open-understory woods (likely on-water, canopy hides the bank); Campground 1's 7-41 sit along an unnamed side stream (NHD ftype 460, a gravel bed), 375-760 m from the river; Campground 3's 119-154 are 34-93 m behind a wooded strip and 155-186 are 100-120 m away with a paved path along the bank between - not on-water. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri leaf-off imagery + UseDirect points + NHD 2026-11-07: CG2 093/094 18-29 m from the Roaring River on open gravel bank, no road between; CG1 070-072 ~17-20 m through woods; channel 15-25 m -> creekside'.
